title: Pool Sentinel: Dedicated GPU Pool Health & Autoscale Composer
creator: Priya Desai
description: Design an integrated dashboard and control surface for Dedicated GPU pools that surfaces pool health signals, autoscaling policy authoring (scale up/down, predictive vs reactive), and burst credit allocation. Aim for a single-pane-of-glass console view that balances operational clarity for SREs and simple guardrails for product engineers managing reserved capacity.
comments: 2026-02-20 - Kickoff: scoped based on PM brief. Primary goals: operational observability (health/time-series), actionable controls (manual scale, autoscale composer), and cost/burst transparency. Initial constraints: surface read-only metrics for non-admin roles.

2026-02-23 - Research sync: spoke with Infra SRE (Miguel Santos) about current telemetry granularity. We can reliably show per-pool GPU utilization, queued requests, and median tail latency at 15s resolution. KV cache hit-rate only available at pool-level aggregated tags.

2026-02-27 - Low-fidelity sketches shared in design channel. Two patterns proposed: (A) vertical split: left time-series + alerts, right controls and history; (B) compact card grid with expandable composer modal. Team preferred pattern A for on-call clarity.

2026-03-03 - User testing (3 platform engineers): feedback: need explicit indicators for capacity headroom and burst credits. They asked for a quick-action fallback (pin fallback model variant) when pool health degrades. Added a lightweight 'fallback' control to mocks.

2026-03-05 - PM review (Ava Park): prioritize autoscale policy templates and safe defaults. PM requested versioning metadata on policies and a rollback button in the rollout flow. Added 'policy history' chip to controls area.

2026-03-07 - Engineering review (Anna Müller): raised concerns about predictive autoscaling requiring additional telemetry (arrival rate histograms). We agreed to implement predictive toggle as beta feature behind a flag; show estimated improvement lift using historical window only.
2026-03-09 - Accessibility pass: updated color contrast on health status indicators and added text labels for screen readers. Confirmed keyboard navigation for composer modal is feasible.
2026-03-10 - Ready for design review with stakeholders. Attached high-fidelity frames and interaction spec. Next: iterate on copy for burst-credit budgeting and finalize handoff tokens for frontend.
decision_log: Decision: Use single-pane layout (time-series + controls) to prioritize on-call workflows over dense summaries.
Decision: Expose two autoscale modes: reactive (cpu/gpu util thresholds) and predictive (arrival-rate based) with predictive behind feature flag.
Decision: Burst credits shown as a separate budget bar with forecasted depletion based on 7-day peak window; edits to burst allocation require admin confirmation.
Decision: Add 'Emergency Scale' quick-action that triggers a manual increase and optionally applies a temporary policy that auto-removes after X hours.
Decision: Policy changes are versioned and can be rolled back from the policy history panel.
